concepts.title: Atlas — Settings Directory — Qwen 5.8
concepts.design_contract_summary: Directory home of destination rows, two-pane document workspace with left table of contents, managers as inline rooms, search morphs the directory into grouped results.

impacts.requirement: Selecting a destination opens a full Settings workspace with category/subcategory navigation, controlled jump, and scrollspy.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Home destination row opens a document workspace; left TOC tracks scroll; jumps lock scrollspy until settled.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Current s4 bloom modal Settings System contract in PMConcept7
demo_fixture_impacts: Destination directory fixture with status summaries
slint_notes: TOC indicator must be state-driven, not geometry-driven
notes: Bloom modal may remain as quick access only.

impacts.requirement: Every setting row exposes Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective-differs states plus scope, tier, and provenance.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Rows carry badges and a Details disclosure with requested/effective, inherited-from, and managed-by fields.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Inventory tier vocabulary (simple/advanced) vs packet exposure ladder
test_impacts: State badge audit across all nine states
notes: Tier migration required before canonical adoption.

impacts.requirement: Managers render inside the document as rooms without unbounded nested scroll containers.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Provider/Memory/MCP rooms are sections in the single workspace scroller.
slint_notes: Single Flickable with section models; manager rooms are sections, not nested scrollers.

concepts.title: Deck — Settings Command Center — Qwen 5.8
concepts.design_contract_summary: Command-field home with status board and destination modules, sticky subcategory tab strip workspace, console-style managers with requested/effective readouts.

impacts.requirement: Search behaves as a command surface with grouped results and keyboard navigation.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Palette field with grouped dropdown, arrow-key selection, Enter deep-link.
test_impacts: Deep-link lands on correct setting with focus wash
notes: Stable identity targets per second Usage handoff.

impacts.requirement: Crew settings use a dedicated manager preserving requested vs effective composition and completion forecasts.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Crew console shows requested members, admitted concurrency, wave count, guards, reserve, and capacity note sourced from Usage.
demo_fixture_impacts: Three crew templates with capacity notes
notes: Forecast is advisory; runtime owns admission.

impacts.requirement: LSP servers use a dedicated manager: installed/detected state, language coverage, executable/version, scope, startup mode, capabilities, conflicts, health, restart, logs, and formatting ownership.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Deck renders an LSP console with running/idle/not-installed servers, coverage, capabilities, conflicts, health, logs, and restart/start/install/diagnostics actions with honest receipts.
demo_fixture_impacts: Four LSP server fixtures incl. not-installed
test_impacts: Formatting ownership stays explicit when LSP and PM formatter coexist
notes: Cross-concept notes now consistently point to Deck for LSP.

impacts.requirement: Terminal manager demonstrates profiles with preview rather than scalar rows.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Profile consoles with palette swatches and rendered ANSI preview strip.
slint_notes: Preview strip is a small styled Text repeater.

concepts.title: Ledger — Settings as One Document — Qwen 5.8
concepts.design_contract_summary: Single continuous document with numbered chapters, hairline entries, managers as appendices, margin outline with ink marker.

impacts.requirement: Context & Instruction sources are inspectable without exposing a raw prompt.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Appendix lists admitted/omitted sources with reasons, AGENTS.md chain precedence, compaction strategy, and source hashes.
schema_or_event_impacts: Last-turn admission record with omission reasons
test_impacts: Deterministic policy stays outside prompt prose
notes: Admission record would come from Prompt Pipeline telemetry.

impacts.requirement: Humanized taxonomy keeps every required domain discoverable.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Ten chapters map all eleven packet domains; spellcheck lives under General > Language & Writing.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Inventory category ids: ai, branching, web, personas vs humanized chapters
notes: Remapping is a product decision; concepts only evidence it.

impacts.requirement: Skills, plugins, tools, and commands stay related but distinct in one manager.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Appendix tables separate the four inventories with trust, compatibility, availability, invoked counts, and conflict flags.
schema_or_event_impacts: MCP-owned tools keep server identity in unified inventory

concepts.title: Spoke — Settings by Intent — Qwen 5.8
concepts.design_contract_summary: Intent-wing home with A-Z fallback, floating search launcher, right-edge progress ticks, master-detail split views for managers.

impacts.requirement: Persona manager distinguishes definition, runtime metadata, and capsule, with explicit scope and ceiling limits.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Split view inspector shows capsule size, eligibility, scope selector (turn/thread/Goal/project/global/child), child-only restriction, and the no-ceiling-widening note.
demo_fixture_impacts: Nine core personas plus one child-only custom
test_impacts: Child-only personas excluded from Chat defaults
notes: Scope defaults to current thread; bulk apply is separate.

impacts.requirement: Media providers get connection/account/model rigor plus route, capability, safety, cost, fallback, and history.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Media split view lists routes; inspector shows capability, native vs PM-transformed mode, output, safety, cost route, fallback, and generation history.
demo_fixture_impacts: Four media routes incl. degraded fallback and not-configured audio
test_impacts: Unsupported attachment route shows alternate, not failure

impacts.requirement: Intent-grouped home must not hide any domain.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Four wings plus explicit A-Z destination index preserve full discoverability.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Flat category list assumption in current settings inventory UI
notes: Wing membership is a taxonomy decision owned by Plans.

supersedes_or_conflicts_with: PMConcept7-NOTES cites 818 settings; inventory now has 825
notes: Inventory generated 2026-08-02; notes entry predates it.

cross_concept_findings.requirement: Settings deep links target stable identities, not presentation details.
cross_concept_findings.selected_concept_behavior: All four concepts navigate by {category, subcategory, setting, manager} targets.

cross_concept_findings.requirement: Setting value provenance persists with the value.
cross_concept_findings.selected_concept_behavior: Every concept renders source, scope, requested/effective, inherited-from, managed-by.
schema_or_event_impacts: value + source + scope + requested/effective stored together
test_impacts: Reset restores source, not only value

cross_concept_findings.requirement: Spellcheck remains a quiet local service with no autocorrect.
cross_concept_findings.selected_concept_behavior: Underline simulation with suggestion popover offering five explicit actions; browser spellcheck attribute unused.
test_impacts: No automatic replacement under any action
slint_notes: Styled text ranges + PopupWindow; HTML spellcheck is simulation-only per packet.

cross_concept_findings.requirement: Continuation choices are provider/product-specific, never a universal budget setting.
cross_concept_findings.selected_concept_behavior: Per-account 'What happens next' selectors appear only when supported (Anthropic Max exhausted, OpenAI, local server).
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Any universal 'When the budget runs out' setting
demo_fixture_impacts: Exhausted Max profile with reset time and extra usage

cross_concept_findings.requirement: CLI-owned OAuth for Claude CLI and Antigravity CLI; no PM-direct OAuth for them.
cross_concept_findings.selected_concept_behavior: Provider register labels auth owner per account; Antigravity install note states CLI-owned login; Codex CLI demonstrates the installed-but-signed-out state with a CLI-owned login launch; PM-direct OAuth shown only for direct providers.
demo_fixture_impacts: Anthropic Max CLI profile, Gemini CLI profile, Antigravity not-installed
test_impacts: Credential ownership visible without raw tokens
